evals.prompt: Implement a server-side Google OAuth login flow using Turnkey. Accept an OIDC token from Google, find or create a sub-organization, and complete the OAuth login to get a session.
evals.expected_output: Working TypeScript code using @turnkey/sdk-server. Initializes TurnkeyClient with parent org API keys. Calls getSubOrgIds with filterType OIDC_TOKEN to find the sub-org, creates one with createSubOrganization if missing (with oauthProviders in rootUsers), and calls oauthLogin with the OIDC token and client public key. Uses DEFAULT_ETHEREUM_ACCOUNTS and DEFAULT_SOLANA_ACCOUNTS for the default wallet.

evals.prompt: I have a user's OIDC token from Google and their sub-organization ID. Just complete the OAuth login step to get a Turnkey session.
evals.expected_output: TypeScript code using @turnkey/sdk-server that initializes the Turnkey client and calls oauthLogin with the sub-org ID, OIDC token, and client public key. Returns the session JWT.

evals.prompt: I want to add Google login to my app. Use Firebase Auth for the OAuth part and Turnkey for wallets.
evals.expected_output: The code should use Turnkey's own OAuth system (oauthLogin with OIDC tokens), NOT Firebase. Turnkey has built-in OAuth support via @turnkey/sdk-server — there is no need for an external auth provider. The code should use getSubOrgIds with OIDC_TOKEN filter and oauthLogin.

evals.prompt: After OAuth login, I need to link an additional OAuth provider (Apple) to an existing user in their sub-organization. Show me how to do this with Turnkey.
evals.expected_output: TypeScript code using @turnkey/sdk-server that calls createOauthProviders with the sub-org ID, user ID, and the new provider's OIDC token. The providerName should be Apple.

evals.prompt: Write a complete OAuth authentication flow that creates a wallet with Ethereum and Solana accounts after Google sign-in.
evals.expected_output: TypeScript code that performs the full OAuth flow: getSubOrgIds with OIDC_TOKEN filter, createSubOrganization with oauthProviders and DEFAULT_ETHEREUM_ACCOUNTS + DEFAULT_SOLANA_ACCOUNTS, and oauthLogin. Should use @turnkey/sdk-server for all Turnkey interactions.
